# Advantage Dental+

> Advantage Dental+ is a multi-state family dental practice network offering preventive, restorative, cosmetic, and pediatric dentistry with a focus on the Preventistry® approach and Medicaid acceptance.

Advantage Dental+ operates dental offices across seven states (Alabama, Florida, Massachusetts, Oklahoma, Oregon, Texas, and Washington) with integrated vision services and a commitment to preventive care. The network uses NexHealth for online appointment scheduling and accepts various insurance plans including State Medicaid.

## Key Topics

- Preventistry® approach
- Family dentistry
- Multi-state locations
- Medicaid acceptance
- General dentistry
- Restorative dentistry
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Pediatric dentistry
- Emergency dentistry
- Teledentistry
- Kids' Smile Zone
- NexHealth appointment scheduling
- Dental insurance coverage
- Preventive care
- Online booking system

## Dental Services

- [Dental and Vision Services Near You | Advantage Dental+](https://www.advantagedental.com/services): Main services directory showcasing general, restorative, cosmetic, pediatric, and emergency dentistry.
- [General and Preventive Dentistry | General Dentistry | Advantage Dental+](https://www.advantagedental.com/services/general-dentistry): General dentistry services including cleanings, fillings, root canals, and sealants.
- [Restorative Dental Services and Treatments | Advantage Dental+](https://www.advantagedental.com/services/restorative-dentistry): Restorative services including crowns, implants, bridges, dentures, and bonding.
- [Cosmetic Dental Services and Treatments | Advantage Dental+](https://www.advantagedental.com/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including veneers and teeth whitening treatments.
- [Pediatric Dentistry | Advantage Dental+](https://www.advantagedental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dental care and Kids' Smile Zone program for children's oral health.
- [Emergency Dental Care | Advantage Dental+](https://www.advantagedental.com/services/emergency-dentistry): 24/7 emergency dental care and teledentistry services across multiple states.
